dialogclicker.menu.button_save.tooltip: Save the actions that you perform in this dialog
dialogclicker.menu.button_erase.tooltip: Erase the saved & current actions that you performed in this dialog
dialogclicker.midnightconfig.title: Dialog Clicker Config
dialogclicker.midnightconfig.shouldApply: Will the mod apply (perform) actions that you saved in dialogs. Disable this if for example you want to erase actions for a closing dialog.
dialogclicker.midnightconfig.shouldLog.t: General logging toggle, including errors (!). Don't recommend turning off.
dialogclicker.midnightconfig.shouldLogAc: Should the mod log actions being saved.
Should the mod log actions being loaded.
dialogclicker.midnightconfig.shouldLogRe: Should the mod log SNBT of dialogs received from the server or world. Helpful for debug.
Should the mod log JSON of dialogs received from the server or world. Helpful for debug.
